name: Upper Austria
summary: White over red with the state arms: a gold eagle on black beside red and white vertical stripes, under an archducal hat.
origin: The arms combine elements from the Lords of Machland and the Duchy of Austria, recorded from the 14th century. Upper Austria's plain white-red flag is the civil flag; the state flag adds the arms.

symbols.name: Archducal hat
symbols.description: A crown-like hat above the shield.
symbols.meaning: Upper Austria as part of the Archduchy of Austria.

facts: Poland's national flag is also white over red.
clues: White over red with a shield of a gold eagle and stripes, under an archducal hat.
An Austrian state whose capital is Linz.
